request.name: Model Context Protocol endpoint for other AI agents

description.content:
JSON-RPC 2.0 over Streamable HTTP (JSON responses). Methods: `initialize`, `ping`,
`tools/list`, `tools/call`. Tools: `get_protection_readiness`, `get_money_at_risk`,
`review_account`, `approve_action`. `approve_action` only runs when the seller has
turned autopilot on and the proposal is inside the seller's limits; otherwise it is
refused. Name the workspace with the `Mcp-Session-Id` header returned by
`initialize`, or with `?ws=` copied from the dashboard.

item.name: Add a demo dispute and run the agent

request.name: Add a demo dispute and run the agent

description.content: Added as a part of security scheme: apikey

SellerShield is an AI agent that protects a small seller's money on PayPal: disputes
(checked against PayPal Seller Protection), paid orders missing tracking, and overdue invoices.

Other agents and storefronts can use this API to ask SellerShield what money is at risk,
get a proposed action for each item, and approve actions. Every write is bound to a
SHA-256 fingerprint of the exact payload, and dispute evidence must cite records.

Each caller gets an isolated demo workspace through the `ss_ws` cookie; real PayPal
sandbox data is shared. All PayPal calls go to the PayPal sandbox.
